subtitle.en: A prayer from the darkness of the sea

attribution.ar: إِعَادَةُ صِيَاغَةٍ أَصْلِيَّةٌ مُبَسَّطَةٌ (مُسْتَوَى A1) لِقِصَّةِ النَّبِيِّ يُونُسَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ كَمَا وَرَدَتْ فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ.
attribution.en: An original A1 (Level-1) retelling of the story of Prophet Yunus (peace be upon him) as related in the Qur'an (al-Anbiya 21:87-88; as-Saffat 37:139-148). Written for learners of this app; not a translation of any single source. The du'a in sentences 10-11 (لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين) is the verbatim Qur'anic supplication of al-Anbiya 21:87, quoted here in standard MSA orthography rather than mushaf spelling; see suggested-notes.json for provenance and reviewer flags. No isnads or extra-Qur'anic dialogue are invented.
